newsitem.title: UK: Outgoing Conservative Scott says defeat beckons.
newsitem.headline: Outgoing Conservative Scott says defeat beckons.

text.p: Sir Nicholas Scott, who is standing down as Conservative member of parliament for the London seat of Kensington and Chelsea, said on Friday his party was probably heading for defeat at the coming election.
"We'll be in opposition almost certainly...although manifestly everybody is working exceptionally hard to make sure we do win," Scott told BBC local television.
